insight: Raised a $37M Series B led by Theory Ventures in 2025 — backers include In-Q-Tel — for $57M+ total funding.
name: Dropzone AI
tagline: AI SOC analysts that autonomously investigate and triage security alerts 24/7.
description: Dropzone AI puts autonomous AI analysts inside the security operations center: agents that investigate alerts end-to-end across phishing, endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and insider-threat domains without a human in the critical path. It connects to existing tools like Splunk, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, and AWS Security Hub via API, deploying in about an hour, and reports 300+ deployments including UiPath and Zapier.
edge: Ships pre-trained AI SOC analysts that investigate alerts end-to-end out of the box — no playbooks or detection rules to author first.
pros: Deploys in about an hour via APIs
cons: Cloud SaaS only — no self-host option

references.title: Dropzone AI Raises $37 Million for Autonomous SOC Analyst
